import hashlib,json,sys,warnings
from pathlib import Path
import aspose.words_foss as aw
records=[]
for name in ("small","hundred_pages","image_table","repeated_images","mixed_styles"):
 source=Path("/tmp/docweave-current-performance")/(name+".docx")
 with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
  warnings.simplefilter("always")
  doc=aw.Document(source)
  raw=doc.to_bytes("md")
 records.append({"name":name,"source_sha256":hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"markdown_bytes":len(raw),"markdown_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"diagnostic_codes":[d.code for d in doc.diagnostics]})
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps({"module":aw.__file__,"records":records},indent=2)+"\n")
